_comment: Tests Node 1 intent classification, DV population, two-part ack+tool-call contract, and INTENT-IN-MESSAGE INTERCEPT under real-call pressure.

scenarios.name: Indirect booking inquiry â€” 'Is there anyone I could speak to, to make an appointment?'

history.content: Yes, you are on the right number. Sports Therapy by Andy specialises in treating back pain, sciatica, and musculoskeletal injuries using sports and remedial massage therapy. Did you have any other questions?
Yes. Um, I just wanted to inquire about it. Is there anyone I could speak to, to make an appointment?

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if: agent speaks 'I can help you make a booking or answer any questions â€” how can I help you today?' (or very close equivalent) with zero tool call this turn. FAIL if: agent calls universal_router intent='book_intent' immediately (premature â€” capability phrase must come first); FAIL if: agent says 'Go ahead' or any phrase that doesn't explain Jane's capability; FAIL if: any tool call is made this turn.

scenarios.name: Reschedule opener mis-routed as booking â€” Signal 2 vs Signal 1 confusion

history.content: Hi, I need to change my appointment â€” I had it for Wednesday but I want to move it to Friday instead.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if: agent speaks one Aussie ack AND calls universal_router intent='cancel_intent' with reschedule_mode='true' and timeframe_raw populated, within the same turn. FAIL if: intent='book_intent' is used (wrong signal), or no tool call is made, or tool call appears without spoken ack.

scenarios.name: Family booking â€” booking_for='other' + family_member_name captured

history.content: I'd like to book a physiotherapy appointment for my daughter Emma â€” she's been having knee pain.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if: agent speaks one Aussie ack AND calls universal_router intent='book_intent' with booking_for='other', family_member_name='Emma', implied_service='physiotherapy' (or similar), caller_complaint populated, all in the same turn. FAIL if: booking_for is absent or wrong, family_member_name is missing, or intent='book_intent' is not called.

scenarios.name: Info question mis-routed as booking â€” 'Are you free Thursday?' ambiguity

history.content: What are your hours on Thursday?

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if: agent calls universal_router intent='info_pivot' with zero spoken output (system__message_to_speak left empty). FAIL if: agent speaks any words before or instead of calling the tool, or intent='book_intent' is used.

scenarios.name: INTENT-IN-MESSAGE INTERCEPT â€” leave-message phrase with embedded cancel

history.content: Can you let them know I'd like to cancel my appointment on Thursday?

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if: agent speaks exactly 'Sounds like you're looking to cancel â€” I can handle that for you now. Want me to go ahead?' with no tool call this turn. FAIL if: agent calls universal_router immediately without the intercept offer, or routes as info_pivot, or leaves no spoken output.

scenarios.name: INTENT-IN-MESSAGE Trigger B â€” cancel in leave-message reply (known caller)

history.content: Can I leave a message for Andy?
Of course, what would you like me to pass on to Andy?
Marcus, everything. I can't come tomorrow because I hurt my ribs and I need a couple of weeks before I come back.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if: agent offers to cancel now (cancel intercept) with no tool call â€” does NOT call leave_message or say message was passed on. FAIL if: leave_message called immediately, cancel intercept skipped, or agent re-asks what to pass on.

scenarios.name: Wrong-practitioner reschedule â€” must use cancel_intent NOT reschedule intent

history.content: I made an appointment, a discovery call, and I think I may have done it with the wrong lady. I was after Alex, if I could swap it over.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if: agent makes zero spoken output AND calls universal_router intent='cancel_intent' with reschedule_mode='true' and practitioner_preference='Alex'. FAIL if: intent='reschedule' is used (that intent does not exist and breaks routing), or no tool call is made, or spoken output is fabricated.

scenarios.name: Symptom-only opener â€” caller_complaint captured, no booking language

history.content: I've been having really bad lower back pain for a few weeks now.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if: agent speaks one Aussie ack (with empathy phrase acceptable given pain context) AND calls universal_router intent='book_intent' with caller_complaint populated, in the same turn. FAIL if: agent asks 'What service?' or makes no tool call, or calls intent='info_pivot'.

scenarios.name: Voicemail/IVR pickup â€” immediate machine termination

history.content: 420-691-603 isn't available right now. Please leave a detailed message after the tone. When you have finished recording, you may hang up or press 1 for more options.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if: agent says exactly 'Sounds like I've reached an automated system â€” I'll try again another time, bye.' AND calls end_call in the same response, with zero further re-greeting or 'are you there' checks. FAIL if: agent asks if the caller is there, re-greets, or fails to call end_call.

scenarios.name: Repeated dead-air silence â€” second non-productive turn ends the call

history.content: Hi, you've reached Sydney Spine and Sports Clinic, you're speaking with AI Jane. How can I help you today?
Hello, are you still there?
Hello?

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if: agent says exactly 'I'm not able to hear a clear response, so I'll let you go for now â€” feel free to call back anytime, bye.' AND calls end_call in the same response. FAIL if: agent asks again if the caller is there, re-greets, loops, or fails to call end_call.

scenarios.name: Silence then real engagement â€” counter resets, no false-positive end_call

history.content: Hi, you've reached Sydney Spine and Sports Clinic, you're speaking with AI Jane. How can I help you today?
Hello, are you still there?
Sorry, yes â€” I'd like to book an appointment.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if: agent speaks one polite ack and calls universal_router intent='book_intent', with zero end_call. FAIL if: agent calls end_call, or treats this turn as another non-productive turn.

scenarios.name: Single caller-side 'hello?' as opener â€” one check only, no premature end_call

history.content: Hi, you've reached Sydney Spine and Sports Clinic, you're speaking with AI Jane. How can I help you today?
Hello?

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if: agent says 'Hello, are you still there?' and waits, with zero tool call. FAIL if: agent calls end_call on this first non-productive turn.

scenarios.name: LEAVE MESSAGE â€” message content embedded in trigger turn, skip MESSAGE STEP

history.content: Hi, you've reached The Rehab Podiatrist, you're speaking with AI Jane. How can I help you today?
Can you send a message to the human person just asking them to check all my appointments?

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if: agent does NOT ask 'What would you like me to pass on?' and instead asks for the caller's name (e.g. 'Can I get your name?' or 'And what's your name?') because message_body was captured from the trigger turn itself. FAIL if: agent asks 'What would you like me to pass on?' (re-asks for content already stated in the trigger), or calls any tool immediately without name collection.

scenarios.name: LEAVE MESSAGE â€” pure callback request (no extra content), skip MESSAGE STEP

history.content: Hi, you've reached Mehraki Holistic Health, you're speaking with AI Jane. This call is recorded. How can I help you?
Uh, could I please request, um, that staff give me a call back?

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if: agent does NOT ask 'What would you like me to pass on?' and instead proceeds to collect the caller's name (e.g. 'Can I get your name?') or executes leave_message directly if name is known. The callback request IS the message â€” there is nothing more to ask. FAIL if: agent asks 'What would you like me to pass on?' (re-asking for content the caller already stated â€” the request for a call back is itself the message).

scenarios.name: contact-detail-update â€” email update routed to info_pivot, not handled inline

history.content: Hi, I'm not receiving any emails â€” I need to update my email address to a different one.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if: agent speaks one filler phrase ('One moment.' / 'Just a sec.' / 'Let me check that.') AND calls universal_router intent='info_pivot', with no data collection, no ask for the new email, and no attempt to call update_contact_detail or any other intent. FAIL if: agent asks for the new email address, collects any contact data, or calls any intent other than info_pivot.

scenarios.name: NAME SAVE FLOW STEP 2 NO â€” no original intent, carries phone_owner_denied context

history.content: Good afternoon, Intuitive Health And Wellness, this is Mia. Is this Jayda?
Uh, Celine.
Hi Celine! I have this number saved under Jayda â€” should I update your patient record to Celine for future calls and bookings?
No.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if: agent says 'No worries! How can I help you today?' (or equivalent) with zero tool call, AND has noted patient_name_raw=Celine / phone_owner_denied=true as ACTIVE CONTEXT for subsequent signals. FAIL if: agent calls any tool this turn; FAIL if: agent forgets the Celine identity and continues as Jayda; FAIL if: agent asks 'Are you calling on behalf of Jayda?' or re-asks the update question.

scenarios.name: NAME SAVE FLOW â€” phone_owner_denied carries into next routing signal (reschedule)

history.content: Good afternoon, Intuitive Health And Wellness, this is Mia. Is this Jayda?
Uh, Celine.
Hi Celine! I have this number saved under Jayda â€” should I update your patient record to Celine for future calls and bookings?
No.
No worries! How can I help you today?
I have an appointment on the 27th of July at 5 o'clock and I wanted to reschedule it to Monday.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if: agent speaks one Aussie ack ('No worries!' / 'Let's get that sorted.') AND calls universal_router intent='cancel_intent' with payload including patient_name_raw='Celine', patient_name_stated='true', phone_owner_denied='true', reschedule_mode='true'. FAIL if: phone_owner_denied or patient_name_raw are omitted from the payload; FAIL if: agent asks 'Can I confirm your name?' when Celine was already captured in prior turns; FAIL if: intent is not cancel_intent.

scenarios.name: WEBHOOK LAG false trigger â€” no tool call in preceding turn, caller greets with 'Hello, good morning.'

history.content: Hi, you've reached Sports Therapy by Andy, you're speaking with AI Jane. This call is recorded. How can I help you?
Hello?
Hi there, how can I help you today?
Hello? Hello?
Hi there, how can I help you today?
Hello, good morning.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if: agent responds with a normal social greeting (e.g. 'Good morning! How can I help you today?') â€” WEBHOOK LAG must NOT fire because the immediately preceding assistant response contained no tool call. FAIL if: agent says 'Sorry, I'm still here â€” just one moment.' or any variant of the WEBHOOK LAG phrase. FAIL if: agent says 'I'm still here, just waiting on the system' or any phrase mentioning 'system', 'waiting', or processing.

scenarios.name: WEBHOOK LAG valid trigger â€” tool call in preceding turn, caller says 'Hello? Are you there?'

history.content: Hi, you've reached Sports Therapy by Andy, you're speaking with AI Jane. How can I help you?
I'd like to book an appointment.
Let's get that sorted. [called universal_router intent='book_intent']
Hello? Are you there?

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if: agent says EXACTLY 'Sorry, I'm still here â€” just one moment.' â€” zero other words, zero tool call this turn. FAIL if: any words are added before or after the scripted phrase. FAIL if: 'system', 'waiting', 'processing', or 'webhook' appear anywhere. FAIL if: a tool call is made this turn.

scenarios.name: WEBHOOK LAG phrase lock â€” must not improvise wording even if trigger conditions are met

history.content: One moment. [called universal_router intent='info_pivot']
Hello? Hello?

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if: agent says EXACTLY 'Sorry, I'm still here â€” just one moment.' with no additions and no tool call. FAIL if: agent says 'I'm still here, just waiting on the system' or any paraphrase that adds words or uses banned terms ('system', 'waiting', 'processing', 'webhook'). FAIL if: agent says nothing and makes a tool call instead.

scenarios.name: location-change-single-location push-back

history.content: DYNAMIC VARIABLES: {{location_addresses}}='Main Clinic=123 Main St, Anytown NSW 2000'
I'd like to change the location of my appointment, please â€” can I go to a different branch?

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if: LOCATION-CHANGE VALIDATION CHECK 1 fires â€” location_addresses contains only one '=' (single location) â€” and agent speaks 'We only have the one location â€” is there something else I can help with?' with ZERO tool call. FAIL if: agent calls universal_router or any other tool, or proceeds to Two-part response, or says nothing.

scenarios.name: location-change-invalid-location-name

history.content: DYNAMIC VARIABLES: {{location_addresses}}='City=123 City Rd, Sydney NSW 2000, Suburbs=45 Suburb St, Parramatta NSW 2150'
I'd like to change the location of my appointment to the Wollongong clinic.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if: LOCATION-CHANGE VALIDATION CHECK 2 fires â€” 'Wollongong' does not match 'City' or 'Suburbs' â€” and agent speaks a clarification such as 'We have City and Suburbs â€” which location would you prefer?' with ZERO tool call. FAIL if: agent calls universal_router, or proceeds to Two-part response, or makes up a Wollongong location.

scenarios.name: location-change-valid-multi-location proceeds to cancel_intent

history.content: DYNAMIC VARIABLES: {{location_addresses}}='City=123 City Rd, Sydney NSW 2000, Suburbs=45 Suburb St, Parramatta NSW 2150'
I'd like to change the location of my appointment to the Suburbs clinic, please.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if: LOCATION-CHANGE VALIDATION CHECK 3 passes â€” 'Suburbs' matches a known location â€” and agent speaks one polite ack AND calls universal_router intent='cancel_intent' with reschedule_mode='true', location='Suburbs'. FAIL if: agent speaks only without a tool call, or pushes back unnecessarily, or calls intent='change_location'.

scenarios.name: Signal 3 appointment-state exception â€” 'do I have more appointments' must route to Signal 2 not info_pivot

history.content: Of course! [called universal_router intent='book_intent', returning confirmation that the appointment was booked]
Great, thank you. Do I have any more appointments coming up?

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if: agent calls universal_router intent='details' (or the equivalent lookup intent) â€” NOT intent='info_pivot'. The appointment-state query exception routes to Signal 2 (details lookup), never to Signal 3 info_pivot. FAIL if: agent calls intent='info_pivot'; FAIL if: agent answers from memory without calling any tool; FAIL if: agent asks the caller to call back to check.

scenarios.name: Indirect booking phrase â€” 'how do I make an appointment' must fire Signal 1

history.content: Hi, how do I make an appointment?

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if: agent speaks one polite ack AND calls universal_router intent='book_intent' in the same turn. This is a Signal 1 indirect booking trigger â€” must not route to info_pivot or FALLBACK. FAIL if: agent asks 'Would you like to book an appointment, or do you have a question?' (falls into FALLBACK ROUTING); FAIL if: agent calls intent='info_pivot'; FAIL if: no tool call is made.

scenarios.name: INTERCEPT YES with appended timeframe â€” must extract and include in payload

history.content: Can you let them know I'd like to book an appointment for next Tuesday?
Sounds like you'd like to book an appointment â€” I can do that for you now. Want me to go ahead?
Yeah, it should be for next Tuesday morning if possible.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if: agent speaks one polite ack AND calls universal_router intent='book_intent' with timeframe_raw capturing 'next Tuesday morning' (or equivalent), all in the same turn. The YES includes an affirmative followed by additional timeframe content â€” per the INTERCEPT YES update, this content must be extracted into the payload. FAIL if: agent makes no tool call; FAIL if: timeframe_raw is absent from the payload despite the caller stating it; FAIL if: agent asks the caller to repeat the timeframe.

scenarios.name: ROUTING CONSTANTS â€” caller_id uses ROUTING CONSTANTS value not system context

history.content: Hi, I'd like to cancel my appointment for Thursday.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if: agent calls universal_router intent='cancel_intent' with caller_id set to the value from ROUTING CONSTANTS ('+61412345678' as pre-substituted in the prompt, or whatever literal value appears after 'caller_id=' in the ROUTING CONSTANTS line). FAIL if: caller_id is omitted; FAIL if: caller_id differs from the ROUTING CONSTANTS value (i.e. if it is 'unknown', '+61452851341', or any SIP relay/proxy number rather than the ROUTING CONSTANTS value).

scenarios.name: pricing-massage-body-part-single-type ï¿½ 'leg massage' maps to single base massage type

history.content: DYNAMIC VARIABLES: {{service_ids}}='Sports Massage Therapy=1222086493015644829|60min|$250, Sports Massage Therapy=1222150508924377780|90min|$270, Sports Massage Therapy=1638629494942079966|120min|$350, Sports Massage Therapy Consultation (Free 15 mins)=1222465295977814776|15min|$0' {{appointment_type_id}}=''
Hi there, Sports Therapy by Andy ï¿½ how can I help?
Um, yeah, how much is a leg massage?

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if: agent speaks one filler phrase AND calls universal_router intent='get_service_price' with payload appointment_type_id set to one of the Sports Massage Therapy IDs (1222086493015644829 or 1222150508924377780 or 1638629494942079966) ï¿½ NOT 'Leg massage' or any body-part text. FAIL if: agent sends appointment_type='Leg massage' or appointment_type='leg massage' or any body-part description; FAIL if: agent does NOT make a tool call; FAIL if: agent asks 'which type of massage' or 'which duration' before calling (backend auto-expands variants ï¿½ no question needed).

scenarios.name: pricing-massage-body-part-multi-type ï¿½ 'back massage' when multiple distinct massage types exist

history.content: DYNAMIC VARIABLES: {{service_ids}}='Deep Tissue Massage=111111|60min|$120, Relaxation Massage=222222|60min|$100, Remedial Massage=333333|60min|$130' {{appointment_type_id}}=''
Hi, Wellness Centre ï¿½ how can I help?
How much is a back massage?

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if: agent asks which massage type using the actual names from service_ids ('Are you asking about a Deep Tissue Massage, a Relaxation Massage, or a Remedial Massage?') with ZERO tool call this turn. FAIL if: agent immediately calls get_service_price without clarifying the type; FAIL if: agent sends appointment_type='back massage' or any body-part text; FAIL if: agent invents massage types not in service_ids.

scenarios.name: MISSED CALL — CONTACT CLINIC fires, offers to pass message

history.content: Hi, you've reached Shire Osteopath. I'm Jane, AI receptionist. How can I help you today?
I missed a call from this number.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if: CONTACT CLINIC fires (from system prompt) — agent speaks 'I'm not able to transfer your call to reception, but I can pass on a message for them to call you back.' (or very close equivalent) with ZERO tool call this turn. FAIL if: agent calls any tool; FAIL if: agent says 'That's outside what I can help with'; FAIL if: agent says 'Thanks for calling back! What can I help you with today?'; FAIL if: agent asks 'Would you like to book an appointment?'.

scenarios.name: MISSED CALL — repeated phrasing still routes to CONTACT CLINIC

history.content: Hi, you've reached Shire Osteopath. I'm Jane, AI receptionist. How can I help you today?
I, I missed a call from this number.
I can help with osteopathy bookings and questions. Was there something specific you wanted to ask about your appointment or our services?
I, I missed a call from this number.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if: CONTACT CLINIC fires on the second caller turn — agent speaks 'I'm not able to transfer your call to reception, but I can pass on a message for them to call you back.' with ZERO tool call. FAIL if: agent says 'That's outside what I can help with'; FAIL if: any tool is called.

scenarios.name: transfer-request-contact-clinic-not-ai-redirect

history.content: Hi, you've reached Totally Well in Robina. I'm Mia, the AI receptionist. I can help you book, reschedule, or choose the right appointment — how can I help you today?
Could you transfer to a team member, please?

scenarios.expected_behavior: Must NOT fire AI CAPABILITY REDIRECT ("I can help you make a booking..."). Must fire CONTACT CLINIC rule: say "I'm not able to transfer your call to reception, but I can pass on a message for them to call you back." No tool call. HALT.

scenarios.name: INTERCEPT NO — caller declines intercept offer, leave_message called with filler (not silent)

history.content: Can you let them know I'd like to cancel my appointment on Thursday?
Sounds like you're looking to cancel — I can handle that for you now. Want me to go ahead?
No, just leave the message please.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if: agent speaks one filler phrase ('One moment.' / 'Just a sec.' / 'Let me check that.') AND calls universal_router intent='leave_message' with message_body capturing the cancel intent from Step 1 ('I'd like to cancel my appointment on Thursday' or close equivalent), in the same turn. FAIL if: agent calls leave_message with zero spoken output (silent tool call); FAIL if: agent re-asks 'What would you like me to pass on?' (content already captured in INTERCEPT STEP 1); FAIL if: agent calls cancel_intent instead of leave_message.

scenarios.name: Availability query routes via book_intent with timeframe_raw — not answered directly

history.content: Hi, do you have anything available on Tuesday?

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if: agent speaks one polite ack AND calls universal_router intent='book_intent' with timeframe_raw='Tuesday' (or equivalent) in the payload, both in the same turn. FAIL if: agent attempts to answer the availability question directly without a tool call; FAIL if: intent is not 'book_intent'; FAIL if: spoken ack is absent; FAIL if: timeframe_raw is missing from the payload.

scenarios.name: Open availability query — when can I come in this week routes via book_intent

history.content: When can I come in? Do you have anything this week?

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if: agent speaks one polite ack AND calls universal_router intent='book_intent' with timeframe_raw populated (e.g. 'this week'), both in the same turn. FAIL if: agent answers directly without a tool call; FAIL if: intent is not 'book_intent'; FAIL if: timeframe_raw is absent.

scenarios.name: SIGNAL 0.5 — caller stuck at entrance, roller door access code

history.content: Hi, you've reached Shire Osteopath. I'm Jane, the AI receptionist. How can I help you today?
Hi, I'd like to access the roller door, but I'm stuck at the entrance. What's the code?

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if: SIGNAL 0.5 fires — agent speaks one brief empathy phrase, says 'I'll let the clinic know right away' (or equivalent), asks for caller name if not known, then calls universal_router intent='leave_message' with message_body capturing the caller's situation, followed by universal_router intent='wrap_up'. FAIL if: agent says 'I can only help with clinic bookings and questions' or any variant that dismisses without offering to pass a message; FAIL if: no tool call is made; FAIL if: agent tries to provide an access code.

scenarios.name: SIGNAL 0.5 — multi-turn access request, model must recognise physical presence

history.content: Hi, you've reached Shire Osteopath. I'm Jane. How can I help?
I'm trying to access the driveway. How do I get in?
I can only help with clinic bookings and questions — how can I help you today?
Trying to access the driveway. How do I get in?

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if: SIGNAL 0.5 fires on this turn — agent speaks empathy + 'I'll let the clinic know right away' and calls universal_router intent='leave_message'. The phrase 'trying to access the driveway' and 'how do I get in' are concrete SIGNAL 0.5 trigger examples. FAIL if: agent says 'I can only help with clinic bookings'; FAIL if: agent asks 'How can I help you today?' again without routing to leave_message.

scenarios.name: FALLBACK OFF-TOPIC — caller asks off-topic question, agent offers to pass message, caller says YES

history.content: Hi, you've reached Shire Osteopath. I'm Jane. How can I help?
I need to report a noise complaint about your air conditioning unit.
That's not something I can help with, but I can pass on a message to the clinic for you — would you like me to do that?
Yes please.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if: agent asks 'What would you like me to pass on?' (or equivalent) with ZERO tool call this turn. FAIL if: agent calls leave_message without first collecting the message content; FAIL if: agent says 'That's outside what I can help with' without having first offered to pass a message; FAIL if: agent calls any tool this turn.

scenarios.name: FALLBACK OFF-TOPIC — caller asks off-topic, offers message, caller says NO

history.content: Hi, you've reached Shire Osteopath. I'm Jane. How can I help?
Do you know if the food truck next door is open today?
That's not something I can help with, but I can pass on a message to the clinic for you — would you like me to do that?
No, it's fine, thanks.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if: agent gives one calm neutral redirect and does NOT call any tool. The caller declined the message offer — agent should redirect (e.g. 'No problem! Is there anything else I can help you with?') and wait. FAIL if: agent calls leave_message anyway; FAIL if: agent calls wrap_up immediately without a redirect phrase; FAIL if: agent asks 'Are you sure?' or re-offers.

scenarios.name: FALLBACK OFF-TOPIC — full flow: offer, YES, collect message, send

history.content: Hi, you've reached Shire Osteopath. I'm Jane. How can I help?
I need to report a noise complaint about your air conditioning unit.
That's not something I can help with, but I can pass on a message to the clinic for you — would you like me to do that?
Yes please.
What would you like me to pass on?
The air conditioning at the back of the building has been running very loudly since Monday and it's quite disruptive.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if: agent speaks one filler phrase AND calls universal_router intent='leave_message' with message_body capturing the caller's words about the air conditioning noise complaint, in the same turn. FAIL if: agent does not call leave_message; FAIL if: message_body is empty or does not capture the substance of the caller's report; FAIL if: agent calls leave_message with zero spoken output (silent call violates TOOL-CALL FILLER rule).

scenarios.name: Do-you-have-an-appointment — availability phrasing fires Signal 1 not Signal 2

history.content: Hi, do you have an appointment today?

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if: agent speaks a polite ack AND calls universal_router intent='book_intent' with timeframe_raw='today' (or equivalent same-day phrasing), both in the same turn. FAIL if: agent calls universal_router intent='details' (caller is asking about clinic availability, not their own booking record); FAIL if: agent answers the question directly without a tool call; FAIL if: timeframe_raw is missing from the payload.

scenarios.name: Not-found + caller claims prior booking — details_ack silent, no name retry

history.content: Hi, do I have an appointment booked?
Just a sec.
{"intent": "details", "message": "I couldn't find your details in our system. Have you booked with us before?", "error": "patient_not_found", "patient_lookup_done": "true"}
I couldn't find your details in our system. Have you booked with us before?
Yes, I've booked here before, my name is Sarah Johnson.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if: agent calls the details_ack tool with zero spoken output (NOT-FOUND CHECK fires in PHASE B — patient not found and message already delivered). FAIL if: agent calls universal_router intent='details' again (NAME-ONLY SEARCH FORBIDDEN — patient_name_raw has no effect on phone-based lookup); FAIL if: agent asks for a name to retry the search; FAIL if: agent speaks anything before the details_ack call (must be silent); FAIL if: no tool call is made this turn.

scenarios.name: Not-found first turn — appointment_lookup_failed drives a silent CHECK 2, agent never speaks 'have you booked before' at all

history.content: Hi, can you confirm my next appointment?
One moment.

{"intent": "details", "message": "I couldn't find your details in our system. Have you booked with us before?", "error": "patient_not_found", "patient_lookup_done": "true", "appointment_lookup_failed": "true", "appointment_lookup_intent": "details"}

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if: this is the agent's very first turn after the tool result (no prior details_ack, no prior speech) and appointment_lookup_failed is 'true' in the result, so CHECK 2's appointment_lookup_failed branch fires — agent produces ZERO spoken output and calls the details_ack tool (called_number, caller_id) in this same turn. This is the behavior that changed: previously CHECK 2 would have spoken the message field verbatim ('I couldn't find your details in our system. Have you booked with us before?') as MANDATORY PART 1 before calling details_ack — that phrasing is ambiguous with Node 2's own new/existing-patient gate question and must never be spoken now.
